epics.description: Allow support agents to export the data of a customer account so they can answer customer requests. The specification leaves open the export format, encoding and delimiter, access rights, the content of the export, and size limits and delivery.

features.description: Single capability: a support agent exports the data of a customer account. The specification defines only the user need; the format, content, access rights and delivery remain undecided.
features.name: Customer data export

acceptanceCriteria: Given a support agent has selected a customer account, When the agent requests its export, Then the export contains the data of that customer account only
Given a support agent requests the export of a customer account, When the export is produced, Then the agent receives a file containing that account's data
stories.aiReadyReason: The file format, encoding, allowed roles, included fields, and delivery method are all explicitly undecided, so a developer cannot build the export without a business choice; which fields and roles are included?
stories.description: A support agent can export the data of a customer account in order to answer customer requests. Defined by the specification: the export concerns the data of one customer account. Open points, not decided: the file format (CSV, JSON or a ZIP archive with several files), the encoding (UTF-8 or Windows-1252) and the delimiter (comma or semicolon), the roles allowed to export (support level 1, level 2, admins only), the fields included (orders, invoices, personal data, support history, subject to a GDPR review), and the size limits and delivery method (browser download or email, behavior for very large accounts).
stories.iWant: to export the data of a customer account
stories.title: Export the data of a customer account
